Ethiopia noun

also Ethiopian, Abyssinia

classical

Plin. 6.30.35; 6.5.8 (Lewis & Short)
Vulg. Gen. 2.13 (Lewis & Short)
M-O s.v. Ethiopia (Egger)

Aethiopia, Aethiopiae f.

noun, first declension

A country takes a preposition: in Aethiopiam, in Aethiopiā, ex Aethiopiā. For the ancients, the land south of Egypt, with no fixed bounds (Lewis & Short); today the country.

Other words

  • Aethiopicus, Aethiopica, Aethiopicum — Ethiopian

    declension · classical · Plin. 6.196 (Lewis & Short)

  • Abyssinia, Abyssiniae f. — the older modern name, Abyssinia

    noun, first declension · also used · modern · M-O s.v. Ethiopia (Trappen, 1843)

See also Egypt, Kenya, Africa.
